name: Sliced Reveal Slideshow
description: Full-height image slideshow where colored slices wipe away in a staggered sequence to reveal each image, with a zoom-out on the photo, arrow buttons and numbered pagination.
contents: Stacked full-bleed image slides, each covered by colored slices
behavior: Slices slide away with staggered anime.js timing to reveal the image while it scales down
Changing slides first covers the current image with slices, then reveals the next
Each slide sets its own slice count, orientation and entry and exit side
Navigation is locked while an animation runs and wraps around with the arrows
editableByProps: Slide images, slice count, orientation and direction per slide
Animation durations, stagger, delays and easings
Arrow and pagination visibility, slideshow height

needsCodeEdit.change: Change arrow glyphs or pagination style
needsCodeEdit.where: showArrows and showPagination blocks in the returned JSX

fixed: Requires animejs version 3 (default export function API)
Slideshow fills the width of its parent and uses the height prop, 100vh by default
